moves.name: Dead
moves.notes: Always followed by Reattach. No transition in the current official state machine leads to this move. It exists in source, but does not trigger in the normal sequence. If any other Decimillipede segment is still alive, this dead segment is not removed and does not fully die. It becomes non-interactable and waits for "Reattach".

moves.name: Reattach
moves.notes: As long as another segment is still alive, this revives the segment with 25 HP. The Decimillipede group only fully dies when all segments are dead.
